ayuda: Prepare a requirement review from synthetic JSON. Use --salida preparacion, antecedente or aportacion. Select --idioma and --catalogos-dir. Read the material from standard input. Preparing a contribution does not submit or resolve a correction.
seleccion_admision_entrada_invalida: The review could not be prepared. Check the format, references and versions of the supplied material.
seleccion_admision_salida_no_disponible: The result could not be written. Check the destination and prepare it again.
seleccion_admision_causa_fuentes_no_veri: The source and correspondence of the material remain unverified.
seleccion_admision_causa_texto_libre: The requirement is expressed as text. Its interpretation needs competent review.
seleccion_admision_causa_regla_ausente: A versioned rule reference is missing for this requirement.
seleccion_admision_causa_evaluador_pendi: The proposed rule needs an evaluator accepted under the applicable terms.
seleccion_admision_causa_dato_no_aportad: Data or supporting references are missing for this review.
seleccion_admision_causa_acreditacion_pe: The supplied status or evidence needs verification review.
seleccion_admision_causa_rechazo_aplicab: The supplied rejection needs review of its application to this requirement.
seleccion_admision_causa_vigencia_aplica: The supplied dates do not cover the proposed milestone. Review their application under the applicable terms.
seleccion_admision_accion_preparar_aport: Prepare data or evidence for review
seleccion_admision_accion_preparar_revis: Prepare review of the requirement and its support
seleccion_admision_pendiente_bases_unive: Check the applicable terms and the complete requirement list.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_corresponde: Check correspondence with the application. The local summary remains unsubmitted.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_lectura_aut: Obtain minimum facts through an authorised query to their owners.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_identidad_r: Check identity, registered submission and documents through the competent procedure.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_subsanacion: Determine which items may be corrected and under what conditions before issuing a request.
seleccion_admision_pendiente_aprobacion_: Give reasons for decisions and obtain competent approval before publishing lists.
seleccion_aportacion_admision_entrada_in: The contribution could not be prepared. Check the antecedent, requirement and versions of the proposed support.
seleccion_aportacion_admision_pendiente_: Check the proposal against the requirement and the review of the applicable terms.
Check the proposed documents and their correspondence with the fact. A reference does not verify the content.
Determine whether the contribution may correct the requirement and under what conditions under the applicable terms.
Submit the contribution through an accepted procedure, where applicable.
Review the contribution and give reasons for the decision through the competent authority.
Proposed support is missing. Prepare references to the fact and documents for review.
